title: VulkanMod Create Compat
description: Fixes compatibility between VulkanMod and Create.
body:
# VulkanMod Create Compat

A lightweight patch that makes VulkanMod work with Create. Drop it in and play.

## Installation

1. Make sure you have [VulkanMod](https://modrinth.com/mod/vulkanmod) and [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric) installed
2. Place this mod in your `mods` folder
3. Launch the game

## What It Does

- ✅ Fixes startup crashes with VulkanMod + Create
- ✅ Gears, belts, windmills, and all mechanical components render correctly
- ✅ Blueprint deployment and printing work as expected
- ⚠️ Blueprint hand-held preview does not render (visible after deployment)

## FAQ

**Q: Why can't I see the blueprint preview in my hand?**

A: This is a known limitation of VulkanMod. Deployment and building are unaffected.

**Q: Does this affect performance?**

A: No. This mod only applies compatibility fixes with zero performance overhead.

**Q: Which versions are supported?**

A: Currently 1.20.1. Support for 1.19.2 and 1.18.2 is planned.
